name: Venture Business

apr.notes: 24.49% variable APR on purchases. Cash advance APR not stated on product page.

fx_fee.notes: No foreign transaction fees on purchases made outside of the United States.

categories.label: Hotels, vacation rentals and rental cars booked through Capital One Business Travel

rewards.redemption_notes: Redeem miles through travel site, or get reimbursed for travel expenses made with your card. May transfer miles to 15+ partners.

signup_bonus.description: Earn 100,000 bonus miles when you spend $10,000 in the first 3 months.

benefits.title: $50 Annual Travel Credit
benefits.description: Receive an annual $50 travel credit for bookings through Capital One Business Travel.

benefits.title: $50 Annual Statement Credit
benefits.description: Get an annual $50 statement credit for purchases at qualifying advertising or software merchants.

benefits.title: Up to $120 Global Entry or TSA PreCheck Credit
benefits.description: Receive up to a $120 credit for Global Entry or TSA PreCheck every 4 years.

benefits.title: Hertz Five Star Status
benefits.description: Skip the counter at select locations, enjoy a wider selection of rental cars and more, just for being a Venture Business cardholder.

benefits.title: Lifestyle Collection
benefits.description: Unlock premium benefits with every stay, like a $50 experience credit, room upgrades when available and more.

benefits.title: Flexible Miles Redemption
benefits.description: Redeem your miles through our travel site, or get reimbursed for travel expenses made with your card—plus you may be able to transfer miles to one of our 15+ partners.

benefits.title: Capital One Business Travel Access
benefits.description: Complimentary access to an all-in-one business travel management solution.

benefits.title: No Foreign Transaction Fees
benefits.description: Pay zero foreign transaction fees on purchases made outside of the United States.

benefits.title: Free Employee Cards
benefits.description: Track employee spending while earning all the rewards from their purchases.

benefits.title: Extended Warranty
benefits.description: Get free additional warranty and protection on eligible items you purchase with your card.

benefits.title: $0 Fraud Liability
benefits.description: If your card is lost or stolen, you can get an emergency replacement and a cash advance.

benefits.title: Virtual Cards
benefits.description: Make safer payments online without exposing your actual card number with merchants.
